pharma.title: India supplies 20% of global generic medicines; its IP rules WTO-compliant: GTRI
pharma.summary: According to the Global Trade Research Initiative (GTRI), India supplies 20% of global generic medicines and its intellectual property regulations remain fully compliant with WTO norms.

pharma.title: USTR Report Flags India’s Drug Patent Rules
pharma.summary: The United States Trade Representative (USTR) released its latest report highlighting concerns regarding India's drug patent regulations and intellectual property framework.

national.title: Nationwide cell broadcast test alert on May 2; people may receive emergency alert on mobile phones
national.summary: The Department of Telecommunications and the National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA) scheduled a nationwide cell broadcast alert test to enhance India's disaster warning mechanism.

national.title: UPI completes 10 years: The system that replaced cash and rewired India’s economy
national.summary: India's Unified Payments Interface (UPI) marked 10 years of operation, highlighting a decade of transforming digital payments and retail transactions across the nation.

national.title: Offering namaz on public land not a right, rules Allahabad High Court
national.summary: The Allahabad High Court held that offering religious prayers or namaz on public property does not constitute a fundamental constitutional right.

national.title: Indian government publishes classification and regulation framework defining online games
national.summary: The Indian government published a legal framework establishing standardized definitions and regulatory rules for online gaming platforms.

international.title: Philippines ranks 114th in 2026 World Press Freedom Index
international.summary: The Philippines secured the 114th position in the 2026 World Press Freedom Index released on International Press Freedom Day.

international.title: China, India among countries active in foreign interference and spying in Canada, CSIS says
international.summary: The Canadian Security Intelligence Service (CSIS) named India and China among nations allegedly engaged in foreign interference activities in its annual assessment.

international.title: AD1175: Seychellois open to international collaboration, want greater African voice on global platforms
international.summary: An Afrobarometer study found that citizens of Seychelles favor international partnerships while advocating for stronger African representation in global governance.

economy.title: Give our bullion back: India wants its gold under own lock and key
economy.summary: India has initiated measures to repatriate its foreign-stored gold reserves back to domestic vaults managed by the Reserve Bank of India.

economy.title: India can grow above 7.5% without stoking inflation: RBI Deputy Governor
economy.summary: A Reserve Bank of India Deputy Governor stated that the Indian economy possesses structural potential to sustain GDP growth above 7.5% without accelerating inflation.

economy.title: Record low rupee may end India's cheap-money era, force RBI policy shift
economy.summary: The Indian Rupee reaching historic lows against the US dollar has prompted market expectations of a shift in the Reserve Bank of India's monetary policy stance.

science.title: India’s first State-led Centre of Excellence for space tech launched in Bengaluru
science.summary: Karnataka launched India's first state-led Centre of Excellence (CoE) for Space Technology in Bengaluru to harness satellite constellation data for societal applications.

science.title: This protein in your blood could reveal Alzheimer’s risk early
science.summary: Scientific research identified a specific blood protein biomarker capable of detecting early risks associated with Alzheimer's disease prior to symptom onset.

science.title: Can dogs help detect cancer? Study explores breath-based detection
science.summary: A clinical study highlighted the capability of trained canine breath-sniffing methods to detect early chemical markers of cancer.

environment.title: As Energy, War and Climate Collide, a Conference in Colombia Charts a Path Beyond Fossil Fuels
environment.summary: An international climate summit in Colombia focused on strategic frameworks to transition global energy systems away from fossil fuel dependency.

environment.title: Strategic Necessity, Not Destruction: Centre On Great Nicobar Project
environment.summary: The Central Government reaffirmed that the Great Nicobar Development Project serves vital strategic national interests while incorporating ecological safeguards.

environment.title: Heatwaves in India are Starting Earlier and Spreading Wider, Warn Experts
environment.summary: Climate scientists warned that heatwave conditions in India are demonstrating an advancing onset timeline and widening geographical footprint.

sports.title: Medal assured! India crush Chinese Taipei 3-0 to storm into Thomas Cup semis
sports.summary: India defeated Chinese Taipei 3-0 to reach the semifinals of the Thomas Cup badminton tournament, guaranteeing a medal finish.

awards_honours.title: Parveen Shaikh wins Whitley Award for skimmer conservation
awards_honours.summary: Conservationist Parveen Shaikh was awarded the Whitley Award 2026 for her efforts in protecting the endangered Indian Skimmer bird population.

awards_honours.title: University of Chicago honours former CEA Krishnamurthy V Subramanian with top alumni award
awards_honours.summary: Former Chief Economic Adviser Krishnamurthy V. Subramanian was conferred a top alumni achievement award by the University of Chicago.

defence.title: India warns Italy: No defence tech for Pakistan
defence.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh urged Italy not to transfer advanced military technologies or defence equipment to Pakistan during bilateral discussions.

defence.title: Bangladesh summons Indian envoy over remarks of Assam CM Himanta Sarma
defence.summary: Bangladesh summoned the Indian High Commissioner to express official concerns over recent public statements made by Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma.

schemes_appointments.title: Andhra partners Araku Coffee to launch 100 women-led outlets under MEPMA
schemes_appointments.summary: Andhra Pradesh collaborated with Araku Coffee under the Mission for Elimination of Poverty in Municipal Areas (MEPMA) to open 100 women-run retail coffee kiosks.

schemes_appointments.title: Who is Nitin Paranjpe? Infosys’ New vice chairman
schemes_appointments.summary: Nitin Paranjpe was appointed as the Vice Chairman of global IT firm Infosys.

important_days.title: International Labour Day 2026 observed on May 1
important_days.summary: International Labour Day (May Day) was observed globally on May 1 to honor the contributions and legal rights of workers worldwide.

important_days.title: Vesak Day 1 May - United Nations
important_days.summary: The United Nations officially commemorated Vesak Day on May 1 to acknowledge the birth, enlightenment, and passing of Lord Buddha.

mcqs.q: Which Indian state launched the country's first State-led Centre of Excellence (CoE) for space technology in Bengaluru?
mcqs.explanation: Karnataka launched India's first state-led Centre of Excellence for space tech in Bengaluru to utilize satellite constellation data for societal applications.

mcqs.q: Indian conservationist Parveen Shaikh was awarded the Whitley Award 2026 for her conservation work on which species?
mcqs.explanation: Parveen Shaikh received the Whitley Award 2026 for her conservation efforts aimed at protecting the endangered Indian Skimmer bird.

mcqs.q: According to the Global Trade Research Initiative (GTRI), India supplies what share of the global generic medicines market?
mcqs.explanation: GTRI reported that India produces and supplies 20% of the world's generic medicines while remaining compliant with WTO intellectual property standards.

mcqs.q: Under which scheme did the Andhra Pradesh government partner with Araku Coffee to establish 100 women-led coffee outlets?
mcqs.explanation: Andhra Pradesh partnered with Araku Coffee under the Mission for Elimination of Poverty in Municipal Areas (MEPMA) to establish 100 women-managed outlets.

mcqs.q: India guaranteed a medal by defeating Chinese Taipei 3-0 to qualify for the semifinals of which major international sports tournament?
mcqs.explanation: India defeated Chinese Taipei 3-0 to secure a place in the Thomas Cup semifinals, assuring itself of a medal finish.
